from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial data extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str = Field(..., description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="The stock code associated with the company")
    operating_revenue: float = Field(..., description="Operating Revenue amount in CNY or equivalent currency")
    total_operating_cost: float = Field(..., description="Total Operating Cost amount in CNY or equivalent currency")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float = Field(..., description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders amount in CNY or equivalent currency")
    report_period: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="The reporting period date (e.g., 2025-03)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_records: List[CompanyFinancialRecord]
